description: A host's telemetry switched on or off, its line profiling switched on or off, or what a process on its machine profiles named (or its defaults again), at run time: kept by the host, and told to its machine's apps (Info's telemetry).

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

on.description: Telemetry on or off (null: as it is).

line_profiling.description: Line profiling on or off: the host's process, Baude's and Record's each profiling what it's told to while telemetry's on too (null: as it is).

app.description: The process whose profiled functions are named or put back to its defaults: the host's, Baude's or Record's (null: none).

functions.description: What app's process profiles in place of its defaults: functions and modules by their dotted names; empty: nothing (null: as it is).

default.description: True: what app's process profiles is its defaults again (Baude's own pick, lineprofile.DEFAULTS), what was named in their place dropped.
